settings.glyph.label: Glyph
settings.glyph.description: The icon shown while recording. The stopping spinner draws its own frames.
settings.recording_color.label: Recording color
settings.recording_color.description: Leave empty to inherit the widget's own icon color, like every other widget on the bar.
settings.stopping_color.label: Stopping color
settings.stopping_color.description: The spinner shown while the recording is still being written out. Empty inherits.
settings.blink.label: Blink while recording
settings.blink.description: Fade the glyph between the recording color and the inherited one. Does nothing if that color is empty.
settings.show_elapsed.label: Show elapsed time
settings.show_elapsed.description: Count up beside the glyph from the moment wf-recorder starts, not from when the region was picked. Horizontal bars only.
